input: Set a savings target for a home down payment

gold.taskTitle: Set a Savings Target for Home Down Payment
gold.taskDescription: Define a clear, actionable savings goal for a home down payment by gathering key financial and personal details.

questions.title: What is your target price range for the home?
questions.description: Understanding the home price range helps calculate the exact down payment amount needed.

questions.title: What down payment percentage are you aiming for?
questions.description: Common targets are 5%, 10%, or 20% — knowing this defines the total savings goal.

questions.title: By what date do you want to reach this goal?
questions.description: A target date determines the monthly savings rate required to hit the goal in time.

questions.title: How much have you already saved toward this goal?
questions.description: Knowing the current savings balance establishes the remaining gap to close.

questions.title: What is your monthly income after taxes?
questions.description: Net monthly income is essential for calculating a realistic savings contribution amount.

questions.title: Which type of account will you save this money in?
questions.description: The account type (e.g., high-yield savings, investment account) affects growth projections and accessibility.

questions.title: Are there other large expenses competing with this goal?
questions.description: Identifying competing financial priorities helps set a savings rate that is sustainable long-term.
